title: Remembering World War I
description: Browse two memorials in Washington, DC, through three photographs and their sources.
provenance: Prepared teaching collection, not a survey. Historical summaries and photo credits checked against linked NPS pages on 28 October 2026. Points are approximate site locations; do not use them for navigation. Unknown dates and inscriptions remain blank.

records.title: District of Columbia War Memorial
records.description: A memorial to District of Columbia residents who died in service during World War I. Its circular pavilion was also intended for musical performances.
records.source_label: National Park Service: District of Columbia War Memorial
records.location_note: Approximate site point south of the Reflecting Pool, supplied for this teaching map. Not a surveyed or independently verified coordinate.

records.title: World War I Memorial
records.description: A national memorial in Washington, DC, commemorating American service in World War I. This sample includes views of the Pershing statue and the Belvedere.
records.source_label: National Park Service: World War I Memorial
records.location_note: Approximate site point at Pershing Park, supplied for this teaching map. Not a surveyed or independently verified coordinate.
